issues.message: CHK-004 ("Add docs/dev/test-coverage.md describing test:coverage usage") was added in PLAN phase: PLAN scope-plan reviewer GAP-001: A0 B3 spec line 180-181 says 'Document the report in docs/' — a separate commitment from CHANGELOG/decision-doc DONE marker. Adding CHK-004 to close the gap.
4 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Add c8 devDependency + .c8rc.json config + Wire test:coverage npm script are performed simultaneously?)

understanding still has 3 undigested unknowns: c8 latest stable major version (probably 10.x); Whether single-process serial run completes in acceptable time (~30x slower than parallel; expected <10 min for 139 smokes); Whether all 139 manifest smokes pass in serial mode (some may have parallelism assumptions)
